expectations.current: Every child returns and is reaped. Direct correction is finite. Nonfinite/out-of-range direct inputs and an inversion that cannot converge return zero. Indirect nonfinite coordinates may remain nonfinite; supplied time metadata remains unchanged.
expectations.paired: Every successful baseline payload matches current bit-for-bit. Baseline timeouts remain failed outcomes and must become returns. The original six mode/input failures occur under both models and both routes.
expectations.bounds: The one-second subprocess cap is a research safeguard, not a product execution-time promise. The finite sample makes no physical accuracy or neighborhood completeness claim.

plannedRepair: Preserve the existing residual expression, evaluation order and strict 1e-14-degree convergence comparison. Reject nonfinite input and return zero on nonfinite iteration, representational stall, two-state cycle or exhausted finite iteration limit; the public function remains nonthrowing.
controls: raw output saved before assessment including timeout/process error
binary mutation rejects when retained executable is available
